newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PKP's transmission network joins Global One.
newsitem.headline: Polish PKP's transmission network joins Global One.

text.p: Poland's state-owned railway PKP and Global One -- a joint venture of Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and U.S. Sprint -- signed an agreement on Tuesday that enables data transmission exchange between the firms' networks.

Under the accord, called the National Data Carrier, customers of PKP's existing Kolpak transmission network will get an access to over 30 world networks operating under Global One's umbrella, Global's manager for Poland told a news conference on Tuesday.
"Due to the signed agreement PKP's customers will obtain access to integrated data transmission offered by Global One," Piotr Tuzinek said.
Kolpak network's customers are currently parliamentary offices, travel agencies, banks and transport companies.
